# ohmoveagain — open-source pipeline for moving to Croatia

> ohmoveagain is a free, open-source pipeline and guide
> for IT professionals relocating to Croatia (and along Eastern-European
> routes). It breaks the move into five ordered stages — assessment,
> pre-flight, migration, initialization, scaling — each with sourced
> checklists, prerequisites, required documents, and a runway calculator.
> It covers the EU Blue Card, Visa D, work permit, digital nomad residence,
> self-employment, and family reunification, and references MUP (immigration),
> Porezna uprava (tax), and HZZO (health insurance). Available in English and
> Russian. Not legal advice — confirm critical steps with the relevant
> authorities. Maintained by Dmitrii Novikov (https://7nolikov.dev/about/).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://ohmoveagain.com/): what ohmoveagain is and how the pipeline works.
- [Pipeline](https://ohmoveagain.com/pipeline/): the five relocation stages in order.
- [Stage 1 — Assessment](https://ohmoveagain.com/stage/assessment/): model tax residency, cost of living, and whether to move at all.
- [Stage 2 — Pre-flight](https://ohmoveagain.com/stage/pre-flight/): documents, visa route, and preparation before leaving.
- [Stage 3 — Migration](https://ohmoveagain.com/stage/migration/): the move itself and border/entry steps.
- [Stage 4 — Initialization](https://ohmoveagain.com/stage/initialization/): MUP registration, OIB, residence, and health insurance on arrival.
- [Stage 5 — Scaling](https://ohmoveagain.com/stage/scaling/): settling in and longer-term steps.
- [Calculator](https://ohmoveagain.com/calculator/): runway / financial-buffer calculator.
- [Sources](https://ohmoveagain.com/sources/): the verified source links behind every checklist item.
- [Contribute](https://ohmoveagain.com/contribute/): how to submit corrections.
